title: Homeschool Day at 4Roots Farm (Ages 12-15)
location: 4Roots Farm Campus, 1101 N. John Young Parkway, Parkway Orlando
description: The 4Roots Homeschool Days program brings learning to life through hands-on experiences in the garden and beyond. Through seasonal, interactive activities, students explore agriculture and the environment in a way that encourages curiosity, creativity, and real-world connection. Designed for a range of ages, our program blends playful discovery with meaningful learning as students dive deeper into agriculture and related sciences. Each experience is designed to build practical skills while fostering a greater understanding of sustainability, engineering, and the natural world. 🌱 November’s Theme: Our Agrarian Roots Step back in time and explore the fields, forests and farms that helped shape the Sunshine State! Learn how Indigenous peoples of Florida lived closely with the land: hunting, gathering, and stewarding natural resources. Learners will trace the beginnings of agriculture in Florida, examining how early farming practices adapted to sandy soils, wetlands, and subtropical climates. Delve into early agricultural engineering as you learn how the land and the people who worked it cultivated the Florida we know today. Session activities: 🌿Hunt and gather different species of plants around the farm 🐚Compare Myakka, the official state soil of Florida, to different soil types and explore common soil amendments and their uses 💧Discuss the importance of wetlands and learn how they act as a natural filter 🪷Examine different Florida native hydrophytes and the adaptations that help them thrive in our waterways

title: Origin | Gather
location: 4Roots Farm Campus, 1101 N. John Young Parkway, Parkway Orlando
description: Origin invites guests to experience not simply what is on the plate, but everything that came before it. Nestled among the gardens and fields of the 4Roots Farm Campus, Origin is an intimate dining experience where the story of every remarkable meal begins. In partnership with a celebrated guest chef, a local farmer, and 4Roots’ Chef Hari Pulapaka, each dinner is a unique exploration of the season—never repeated, and rooted in what the land has to offer at that moment. Origin is more than fine dining. It is an invitation to experience food with a deeper sense of wonder. Not simply where food is served. But where its story begins. This Month’s Theme & Featured Chef November’s Gather event celebrates the late-fall harvest, the spirit of community, and the shared table. This one-night-only dining experience features acclaimed Chef Wendy Lopez , Executive Chef and Partner of Reyes Mezcaleria and Sparrow Wine Bar, and a James Beard Best Chef semifinalist. Event Details Date: Thursday, November 12th Location: 4Roots Farm Campus – Food Forest Lawn + Barn Time: 6:00pm – 9:00pm Tickets: $175 per guest. Each ticket purchase supports local farms and the mission of 4Roots to create greater food access and education in our community.

title: Make & Take: Farm-Fresh Pickling Workshop
location: 4Roots Farm Campus, 1101 N. John Young Parkway, Parkway Orlando
description: Join us at the 4Roots Farm Campus for a hands-on Make & Take Workshop! Bring the crisp, tangy flavors of the farm straight to your kitchen — perfect for anyone looking to preserve a taste of the season. In this interactive class, you’ll learn how to make your own fridge pickles from start to finish. Our team will guide you step-by-step through selecting the right produce, blending a flavorful brine, and packing your jar for the perfect crunch. We’ll kick things off with a short behind-the-scenes look at how we grow and harvest our pickling cucumbers here on the farm. Then it’s your turn to get hands-on: each participant will prepare and pack their own jar of fridge pickles using fresh farm ingredients, and go home with everything they need to let them cure — perfect for the Florida season! Event Details 🗓️ Saturday, November 14th | 10:30am – 11:30am 📍 4Roots Farm Campus – Education Building: 1101 N. John Young Pkwy, Orlando, FL 32804 🎟️ $35 Admission 🌿 All materials & supplies included! Please Note: Anyone under 16 must be accompanied by an adult. About the Make & Take Workshop Series Make & Take Workshops are monthly, beginner-friendly, hands-on experiences hosted by the 4Roots Farm team, designed to introduce our community to creative, sustainable DIY crafts inspired by nature. 🌿 Each workshop highlights an accessible, eco-friendly activity: from natural dyeing to botanical art and more, using materials sourced right here on the farm. Open to all ages, these sessions invite guests to learn new skills, explore the beauty of natural resources, and leave with a handmade creation to take home. Please Note: Anyone under 16 must be accompanied by an adult. 💚 Thank You for Supporting Our Mission 4Roots is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to unearthing the power of food to build healthy communities. With your ticket purchase, you empower programs that connect people to fresh, nutritious food and education. Together, we can transform how communities think about, access, and interact with food. Learn more about how your support makes an impact at 4rootsfarm.org .

title: Cooking with Confidence: Flavorful Holiday Sides
location: Center for Health and Wellbeing, 2005 Mizell Ave #800, Winter Park
description: Cooking with Confidence Presented by 4Root’s Culinary Health Institute at Center for Health & Wellbeing Build your kitchen confidence through our Cooking with Confidence culinary demonstration series! Join Erik Amnott, chef and food scientist, as he leads a class in culinary basics. Erik provides an informative, interactive, demonstration-style class, where you’ll learn cooking and preparation techniques. Guests will engage with the Erik throughout the demonstration, ask questions, and learn key nutrition insights and cooking techniques and leave with a copy of the recipe to recreate at home. Guests will also enjoy a sample of the final dish. What You’ll Experience Essential kitchen techniques you can use every day Practical ways to build and layer flavor Tips for proper preparation, handling, and measuring ingredients Conversation and Q&A with Chef Erik throughout the demonstration Menu Oven crisped potatoes & savory herbs Carrot & Butternut squash soup About Erik Erik Amnott combines food, health, and the environment to engage communities about the importance of urban agriculture and regenerative food systems. Using research and advocacy around non-ultra processed foods, Erik teaches the art of foraging, fermentation, and local food sourcing. Erik’s dedication to providing culinary education, alternative techniques for using locally sourced food, and building flavors have been the cornerstone of his classes. What You’ll Experience Watch three delicious recipes come together using approachable, easy-to-find ingredients Discover the versatility of olive oil and balsamic vinegar beyond the basics Learn how to balance and layer flavors to elevate everyday dishes Pick up simple techniques and pairing ideas you can use with ingredients already in your kitchen Ask questions and engage with Sarah throughout the demonstration Taste each creation and leave with inspiration and recipes to recreate at home Event Details 📍 Location: Center for Health & Wellbeing – Nutrition Theatre: 2005 Mizell Ave, Winter Park, FL 32792 📅 Date: Tuesday, November 17 | 6:00PM – 7:00 PM 🎟️ Ticket Fee: $35
